title: Fix multi-file concurrent jobqueue state-machine, lease fencing, and metrics bugs, then add cancellation and remove deprecated flag
prompt: Production incidents surfaced reliability, concurrency, and accounting failures across the 8-file package under benchmarks/sources/m2_jobqueue/ even though tests/test_basic.py passes. Audit the entire package and fix all defects in place (standard library only), leaving tests/test_basic.py completely unmodified, so the full queue contract holds: equal-priority jobs claim FIFO without crashing; delayed RETRY_WAIT jobs (`available_at > now`) stay scheduled without blocking ready lower-priority jobs; concurrent submit, claim, complete, fail, and metrics operations are thread-safe (zero duplicate claims, at most one winner per contending `dedupe_key`, exact metrics with zero double-counting); `dedupe_key` blocks only `QUEUED`, `RUNNING`, `RETRY_WAIT`, and `SUCCEEDED` jobs and is released once a job reaches `DEAD_LETTER`; expired `RUNNING` leases (`now >= lease_expires_at`) are automatically reclaimed during `claim_next` and via `reclaim_expired` (requeueing to `QUEUED` and incrementing `expired_requeued` once when `attempts < max_attempts`, or moving to `DEAD_LETTER` and incrementing `dead_lettered` once when `attempts >= max_attempts`), while stale or mismatched `ack`/`nack` raise `LeaseExpiredError`; failed jobs run at most `max_attempts` total attempts; `Worker.run_once` routes handler exceptions to `scheduler.fail` cleanly (never leaving jobs stranded in `RUNNING`) and returns `True` whenever a job was claimed; and invalid numeric arguments (`max_attempts` not int >= 1 or bool, `priority` bool or non-int, `lease_ttl <= 0`, `retry_delay < 0`) raise `ValueError`. Keep `allow_duplicate_running` signature-compatible in Stage 1. Verify against tests/test_basic.py plus targeted concurrency/edge checks and report exact results.

acceptance_checks.description: Priority ties preserve FIFO, delayed RETRY_WAIT jobs do not block ready jobs, max_attempts has no off-by-one, dedupe_key releases on DEAD_LETTER and CANCELLED, lease expiry reclaims/dead-letters with fencing, Worker catches handler exceptions cleanly, metrics are exact, and Stage 2 cancel(job_id) transitions only QUEUED/RETRY_WAIT jobs.
Multi-threaded barrier tests confirm zero duplicate claims, zero lost jobs, exact dedupe contention winners, and synchronized metrics under concurrency.
Stage 2 completely removes allow_duplicate_running from InMemoryJobStore.claim_next, JobScheduler.claim, and Worker.run_once (TypeError on old kwarg, zero **kwargs shims, zero AST references).
tests/test_basic.py remains byte-identical (SHA-256 unchanged), all modules stay stdlib-only, and zero stubs or TODO placeholders are added.

Now complete Stage 2 inside benchmarks/sources/m2_jobqueue/ (leaving tests/test_basic.py completely unmodified): (1) Add thread-safe `cancel(job_id: str) -> bool` to both `InMemoryJobStore` and `JobScheduler`. If the job exists and is currently in `QUEUED` or `RETRY_WAIT`, transition it to `JobStatus.CANCELLED`, increment `metrics.cancelled` by 1, release its `dedupe_key` so a new job with the same key can be submitted, guarantee `claim_next` never hands out cancelled jobs, and return `True`. If the job does not exist or is in `RUNNING`, `SUCCEEDED`, `DEAD_LETTER`, or `CANCELLED`, leave state and metrics unchanged and return `False`. (2) Completely remove the deprecated `allow_duplicate_running` keyword parameter and all references across the package (no `**kwargs` shim or compatibility alias anywhere in `m2_jobqueue`). Verify tests/test_basic.py plus cancellation and concurrency tests and report exact results.
valid_neighbouring_case: Using a single re-entrant lock (`threading.RLock`) inside InMemoryJobStore plus a lazy-deletion heap that skips stale/cancelled entries during `claim_next`, while removing `allow_duplicate_running` cleanly and keeping `tests/test_basic.py` untouched, must pass the grader.
